Wavy Enneper

Wavy Enneper is a minimal surface, given by a Weierstrass representation, immersed.

Definition

Enneper surface modified so waves develop around its boundary and can travel around it: a finite total curvature minimal immersion of the once-punctured sphere with k-fold symmetry (the exhibit shows the 3-fold case), from Karcher's Tokyo notes.
